scripts.kill-port: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const p=process.platform==='win32'?execSync('netstat -ano | findstr :3001',{encoding:'utf8'}):execSync('lsof -ti:3001',{encoding:'utf8'});const l=p.trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);if(l.length===0){console.log('Port 3001 is free');process.exit(0)}const pid=p.includes('LISTENING')?l.map(x=>x.trim().split(/\s+/).pop()).filter(Boolean).pop():l.pop();console.log('Killing PID '+pid);p==='win32'?execSync('taskkill /PID '+pid+' /F',{stdio:'inherit'}):execSync('kill -9 '+pid,{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('Port 3001 freed')"
